items.question: What types of dance videos can I make?
items.answer: You can create TikTok viral dances, K-Pop choreography, hip-hop moves, gentle sways, baby dances, pet dances, wedding dances, and more. We have 20+ templates across 8 categories.

items.question: What photo formats are supported?
items.answer: We support JPG, PNG, and WebP images. For best results, use a clear photo where the subject's face is visible and front-facing. Photos should be at least 512x512 pixels.

items.question: How long does it take to generate a video?
items.answer: Most dance videos are generated in 30-60 seconds. The AI processes your photo and applies the dance motion in real-time.

items.question: Can I use the videos commercially?
items.answer: Yes. Videos you generate are yours to use for any purpose, including social media content, marketing materials, and commercial projects.

items.question: Is there a watermark on the videos?
items.answer: No. All generated videos are watermark-free and ready to use immediately.

items.question: What video resolution do I get?
items.answer: Videos are generated in 720p HD quality in vertical 9:16 format, optimized for mobile viewing and social media platforms.
